This was my perception before. I really thought it was only Him that was lacking in my life and having a relationship will save me from depression. But no, my faith plays a big part in my life yet I still face depression everyday. It doesn’t choose.

It’s the third day I woke up with anxiety in my heart—feeling empty, a little lost and that desire to disappear again. But this time, I no longer dwell on it & decide to live with it instead. Carrying on my day with hope that I’ll survive today. And guess what, I did. 💛
